svg.title: Review figure captions with one reusable skill
svg.desc: A check-figure-captions skill reviews each figure with its caption. The birthweight caption omits the exposure comparison, units, and meaning of the intervals. The plotting code supports a correction. An illustrative map of Millford in 1850 already explains its shading, so the caption is kept.
svg.text: Review a figure and its caption together
Read the caption with the figure.
Identify what a reader has to guess.
Verify missing details in the source.
